secrets.name: RIOT_API_KEY
secrets.description: Riot Games API key from https://developer.riotgames.com. Development keys expire after 24 hours, so a fresh one is needed daily until the app is approved for a production key.

secrets.name: RIOT_ID
secrets.description: Your Riot ID in the form GameName#TAG, for example ShadowFox#BR1. Used to find which matches to pull.
